# Expense Category

One kind of spend (Travel, Client meals, Office supplies and so on) with an English and a Malay label, the expense account a bill line posts to, and the highest amount one receipt may claim. A receipt over the cap is flagged for the approver, not refused.

Part of Expense Claims.
